hub._relay_comment: A standalone worker sends its chat events to the backend's hub (services/chat/relay.py): at most relay_queue_size wait to go, relay_batch_size to a frame.

commands._comment: Slash commands every workflow's chat offers (get_chat_context); an employee's apps add theirs (employee_apps.json commands). fill is the text the command puts in the message box; suggest also shows it in an empty chat. {name} is the employee's name.

generic.fill: Summarize what we’ve agreed so far.
